# Sector

Qualified name: `manim.mobject.geometry.arc.Sector`

class Sector(*radius=1*, *\*\*kwargs*)
:   Bases: [`AnnularSector`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.geometry.arc.AnnularSector.html#manim.mobject.geometry.arc.AnnularSector "manim.mobject.geometry.arc.AnnularSector")

    A sector of a circle.

    Examples

    Example: ExampleSector

    ![../_images/ExampleSector-1.png](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/_images/ExampleSector-1.png)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class ExampleSector(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            sector = Sector(radius=2)
            sector2 = Sector(radius=2.5, angle=60*DEGREES).move_to([-3, 0, 0])
            sector.set_color(RED)
            sector2.set_color(PINK)
            self.add(sector, sector2)
    ```
